nvitk.gui.sge.job
=================

.. py:module:: nvitk.gui.sge.job

   .. py:attribute:: param
      :type:  str


   .. py:attribute:: file
      :type:  str


   .. py:attribute:: layer_name
      :type:  str


.. py:class:: GuiSgeJob

   A GUI-staged tool invocation ready for local export and remote SGE submission.


   .. py:attribute:: job_id
      :type:  str


   .. py:attribute:: tool_id
      :type:  str


   .. py:attribute:: params
      :type:  dict[str, Any]


   .. py:attribute:: target_mode
      :type:  str


   .. py:attribute:: label_ids
      :type:  list[int]


   .. py:attribute:: input_name
      :type:  str
      :value: 'input.nii.gz'



   .. py:attribute:: output_name
      :type:  str
      :value: 'output.nii.gz'



   .. py:attribute:: aux_layers
      :type:  list[AuxLayerSpec]
      :value: []



   .. py:attribute:: gpu
      :type:  bool
      :value: False



   .. py:method:: to_dict() -> dict[str, Any]

      Serialize this job to a JSON-safe dict (``job.json`` payload), keying ``aux_layers`` by
      parameter name.



   .. py:method:: from_dict(data: dict[str, Any]) -> GuiSgeJob
      :classmethod:


      Parse a ``job.json`` payload back into a :class:`GuiSgeJob` (inverse of :meth:`to_dict`).



.. py:function:: build_remote_paths(remote_job_root: str) -> tuple[str, str, str]

   Return ``(data_root, output_root, submit_script_path)`` on the cluster.


.. py:function:: stage_job_locally(viewer: Any, layer: Any, *, tool_id: str, params: dict[str, Any], target_mode: str, label_ids: list[int] | None, gpu=False) -> tuple[pathlib.Path, GuiSgeJob]

   Export inputs + ``job.json`` under a local staging directory.


.. py:function:: emit_gui_sge_script(job: GuiSgeJob, *, local_staging: pathlib.Path, remote_job_root: str) -> pathlib.Path

   Write ``submit.sh`` into *local_staging* with cluster-side bind paths.
